description_en: Queries the latest available image in a specified image family
description_zh: 调用DescribeImageFromFamily查询指定镜像族系内最新的可用镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-image-from-family --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-family hangzhou-daily-update --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageFromFamily

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the image. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 镜像所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image family.

Custom images, public images, community images, and shared images all support image families. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174241.html
parameters.help_zh:
镜像族系名称。

自定义镜像、公共镜像、社区镜像、共享镜像均已支持镜像族系，使用方法及介绍请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174241.html
parameters.name: image_family

Architecture.description_en:
The system architecture type of the image. Valid values:
i386
x86_64
Architecture.description_zh:
镜像系统架构类型。可能值：
i386
x86_64

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the image was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 镜像的创建时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

DiskDeviceMapping.description_en: The mappings between disks and snapshots in the image
DiskDeviceMapping.description_zh: 镜像下包含云盘和快照的映射关系

Device.description_en:
The device information of the disk, such as /dev/xvdb.
This parameter will be deprecated. To ensure compatibility, do not use this parameter
Device.description_zh:
云盘的设备信息，例如/dev/xvdb。
该参数即将停止使用，为提高代码的兼容性，建议您尽量不要使用该参数

ImportOSSBucket.description_en: The OSS bucket that contains the imported image

ImportOSSObject.description_en: The OSS object that corresponds to the imported image

Size.description_en: The size of the disk. Unit: GiB

ImageOwnerAlias.description_en:
The alias of the image owner. Valid values:
system: public image.
self: your custom image.
others: public image of another user.
marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image
ImageOwnerAlias.description_zh:
镜像所有者别名。可能值：
system：公共镜像。
self：您的自定义镜像。
others：其他用户的公开镜像。
marketplace：云市场镜像

IsCopied.description_en: Indicates whether the image is a copy of another image

IsSelfShared.description_en: Indicates whether the custom image has been shared with other users
IsSelfShared.description_zh: 是否共享过该自定义镜像给其他用户

IsSubscribed.description_en: Indicates whether you have subscribed to the Terms of Service for the image product that corresponds to the product code
IsSubscribed.description_zh: 是否订阅了该镜像商品码对应的镜像商品服务条款

IsSupportIoOptimized.description_en: Indicates whether the image can be used on I/O optimized instances
IsSupportIoOptimized.description_zh: 是否可以在I/O优化实例上运行

OSName.description_en: The China-locale display name of the operating system
OSName.description_zh: 操作系统的中文显示名称

OSType.description_en:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:
windows
linux
OSType.description_zh:
操作系统类型。可能值：
windows
linux

ProductCode.description_en: The product code of the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image
ProductCode.description_zh: 镜像市场的镜像商品标示

Progress.description_en: The image creation progress, in percent
Progress.description_zh: 镜像完成的进度，单位为百分比

Size.description_en: The size of the image. Unit: GiB

Status.description_en:
The status of the image. Valid values:
UnAvailable: unavailable
Available: available
Creating: being created
CreateFailed: failed to be created
Status.description_zh:
镜像的状态。可能值：
UnAvailable：不可用
Available：可用
Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败

Tag.description_en: The tag key-value pairs of the image

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the custom image

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the custom image

Usage.description_en:
The type of resource to which the image is associated. Valid values:
instance: one or more ECS instances have been created from the image.
none: no ECS instances have been created from the image
Usage.description_zh:
有引用关系的资源类型。可能值：
instance：创建了一台或多台ECS实例。
none：未创建过ECS实例
